title: Bad Trip
summary: Before a work trip, a party and an unsettling night turn Jason toward a mirror of himself. He has spent years trying to shed the Jason others knew, only to find that being Jason still matters to him.

portal.scene: Jason sits before a gilded mirror holding another version of himself; records, old photographs, work, travel and fractured memory circle the room.
portal.motif: Seeing the self he tried to leave behind
